title: Big Holiday Cheer Comes In Mini Packages With The Return Of The Burger King® Advent Calendar
text:
Big Holiday Cheer Comes In Mini Packages With The Return Of The Burger King® Advent Calendar 
 Press Releases Blog Posts Media Assets Media Contact Search Search Press Releases • November 5, 2026 Big Holiday Cheer Comes In Mini Packages With The Return Of The Burger King® Advent Calendar
 MIAMI, FL, November 5, 2026 —It's the most Whopper-ful® time of the year, and Burger King® is bringing back one of its most sought-after holiday collectibles in a whole new way. The limited-edition BK Advent Calendar is returning for the 2026 holiday season, but fans will need to act fast to get their hands on one.  This year’s highly anticipated drop gives lucky fans the chance to build their very own Burger King restaurant featuring minis. Tapping into the growing craze for all things mini, the calendar features 12 days of tiny BK surprises that come together to create one festive, flame-grilled holiday keepsake.
 “We know Guests will be excited that for the third year in a row, the Advent Calendar is back, and it’s the best one ever,” said Joel Yashinsky, Chief Marketing Officer, Burger King US&C. “These limited-edition Advent Calendars sell out fast, and we know our Guests are always looking for more holiday fun from BK. So this year, fans can build their very own BK restaurant, complete with a mini-Whopper®, nuggets and other items that make BK feel like BK. It’s our one-of-a-kind way to celebrate the season, and we can’t wait for families to bring a little BK home for the holidays!”
 Behind each of the calendar's 12 doors is a new piece of the Burger King experience, reimagined in miniature form. From fan-favorite menu items that have defined this year like the iconic Whopper® in its new box packaging and new nuggets, to restaurant details like the King's Booth, and a soda fountain, and holiday items like a reindeer and tree, the calendar packs some of the brand's most recognizable elements into one merry little package.  
 And on Day 12, it all comes together! The individual pieces transform into a complete miniature Burger King restaurant, perfect for displaying on its own or adding a little flair to a holiday village. As an extra holiday treat, the final door reveals a miniature $5 BK digital coupon for Royal Perks members to cap off the countdown. Part collectible, part hands-on holiday fun, the calendar is designed to bring a little extra joy to collectors, families, holiday enthusiasts and Whopper fans alike. 
 Ready to build a little BK of your own? Don’t wait! The limited-edition, one-of-a-kind 2026 BK Advent Calendar, featuring an entirely custom design, will be available for $19.54, a nod to the year Burger King was founded.  
 Sold exclusively on BKAdventCalendar.com, 110 calendars will be available daily beginning Monday, November 16 at 12 p.m. ET through Friday, November 20, while supplies last.** With the past two calendars selling out in under five minutes, fans are encouraged to mark their calendars before this year’s drop is gone! 
 For more information on Burger King, to become a Royal Perks member, or to find your nearest restaurant, please visit www.bk.com or download the BK app. Be sure to follow @BurgerKing on Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok for the latest news, menu updates and more. 
 *2026 BK Advent Calendar sale dates, 11.16.2026 – 11.20.2026, 9a EST / 12 PST. Limited quantity drops. While daily supplies last. Limit one advent calendar per order, household, address, name and email, duplicate orders will be deleted.  Free standard shipping to the 48 contiguous U.S. states and D.C. only (no AK, HI, territories, or P.O. boxes).  Advent calendars ship the week of 11.30.2026, actual delivery times will vary.  Cannot be combined with other offers / coupons.  Final Sale. No exchanges, returns or substitutions. Burger King® reserves the right to modify or terminate this promotion at any time without notice and in its sole discretion.  WARNING:  Choking Hazard. Small parts. Not for children under 3 years old. For questions about your order or to report a shipment issue, contact support@whitestonebranding. This offer is subject to the Royal Perks Terms and Conditions at bk.com/royalperksterms, incorporated by reference; in the event of a conflict, these offer terms govern with respect to this offer. Burger King® reserves the right to modify or terminate this offer at any time, without notice, and in its sole and absolute discretion, including to address fraud, abuse, or technical errors. Sponsor: Burger King Company LLC, 5707 Blue Lagoon Drive, Miami, FL 33126.  
 HOW TO REDEEM $5 BK OFFER: 
 Account registration required .   Open only to Royal Perks members who are registered and logged in to a valid Royal Perks Account and who have reached the age of majority in their state of residence. Scan the QR code.  Promo Code will auto-populate in the BK app. Click, “APPLY”.  Go to the Offers tab select “$5” to redeem.  Cannot be combined with any other offer, digital exclusive or value. Not valid on delivery.  
 Advent Calendar Contents - Miniature sizing: Whopper and box - 1.5” x 1.5”, fries and tray - 1” x .75”, nuggets and sauce - 1.5” x 1”, ice cream cone - 1” x 2”, King’s Booth - 4.25” x 2.125”, kitchen prep station - 3” x 1.5”, soda machine - 2” x 2.75”, team member - 3.5” x 1.5”, Guest - 3.5” x 1.5”, reindeer - 3” x 2.25”, holiday tree - 2.35” x 4” 
 ABOUT BURGER KING® 
 Founded in 1954, the Burger King® brand is a global quick service hamburger chain known for food quality and value and as the only place guests can get the iconic flame-grilled Whopper® sandwich. The Burger King system operates more than 19,000 locations in more than 120 countries and U.S. territories. Nearly all Burger King® restaurants are owned and operated by independent franchisees, many of them family-owned operations that have been in business for decades. To learn more about the Burger King brand, please visit the official brand website at www.bk.com or the newsroom at news.bk.com, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok.
